Good afternoon, and thank you all for joining today's call.","zh":"谢谢，艾琳。下午好，感谢大家参加今天的电话会议。"},{"id":21,"startTime":512.34,"endTime":537.03,"speaker":"Stefano Caroti","speakerType":"management","en":"For the first time in Deckers' history, we delivered over $1 billion of revenue in the first quarter, as total company revenue increased 5.7% versus last year, and diluted earnings per share was $0.94, both above our expectations for the quarter. As anticipated, performance was led by total company DTC, which increased 13% versus last year.","zh":"在 Deckers 历史上，我们第一次在第一季度实现了超过 10 亿美元的收入，公司总收入比去年增长了 5.7%，摊薄后每股收益为 0.94 美元，均高于我们对本季度的预期。正如预期的那样，公司整体 DTC 的表现领先，与去年相比增长了 13%。"},{"id":22,"startTime":537.03,"endTime":561.57,"speaker":"Stefano Caroti","speakerType":"management","en":"Both HOKA and UGG maintained solid momentum and continued to capture high level of full price consumer demand, driving global DTC revenue growth of 17% and 6% respectively. Wholesale channel growth was in line with our expectation, which included planned international shipment timing differences moving later this year as compared to last.","zh":"HOKA和UGG均保持强劲势头，继续抓住高水平的全价消费者需求，带动全球DTC收入分别增长17%和6%。批发渠道的增长符合我们的预期，其中包括与去年相比，今年晚些时候计划的国际发货时间差异。"},{"id":23,"startTime":561.57,"endTime":569,"speaker":"Stefano Caroti","speakerType":"management","en":"Underlying consumer demand for our brands remains strong across international markets and domestically.","zh":"国际市场和国内消费者对我们品牌的潜在需求仍然强劲。"},{"id":24,"startTime":569,"endTime":584.03,"speaker":"Stefano Caroti","speakerType":"management","en":"HOKA and UGG each delivered healthy first quarter growth and full price unit sell-through in the U.S. market. Our teams are bringing new and innovative ideas to market at the right time while staying focused on quality, authenticity, and long-term brand health.","zh":"这些结果增强了我们对 2027 财年前景和多年框架的信心。我们的团队在适当的时间将新的创新理念推向市场，同时专注于质量、真实性和长期品牌健康。"},{"id":28,"startTime":650.42,"endTime":682.26,"speaker":"Stefano Caroti","speakerType":"management","en":"We remain committed to the fundamentals that have long differentiated Deckers, building powerful brands, preserving a pull model of demand, and investing with purpose to enhance our competitive positioning and capitalize on the opportunities ahead. The breadth of DTC demand across HOKA is the result of our targeted investments in capabilities across technology, design, color, lifestyle, and marketing, which have allowed HOKA to expand consumer appeal for a wider array of styles.","zh":"消费者对这些车型、路线和生活方式的有意义的参与让我们深受鼓舞，这些因素共同贡献了本季度全球 HOKA DTC 增长的一半以上。 HOKA 对 DTC 需求的广泛性是我们对技术、设计、色彩、生活方式和营销能力进行有针对性投资的结果，这使得 HOKA 能够扩大消费者对更广泛款式的吸引力。"},{"id":36,"startTime":804,"endTime":832.77,"speaker":"Stefano Caroti","speakerType":"management","en":"This provides HOKA with an even greater opportunity to expand closet share with existing consumers and attract new consumers through models that offer a distinct HOKA performance experience, while extending into lifestyle wearing occasions. We expect the benefits of these investments to continue building season after season with current product assortment representing early days of this strategic elevation and even more exciting things to come in Spring 2027 and beyond.","zh":"这为 HOKA 提供了更大的机会，扩大现有消费者的衣橱份额，并通过提供独特 HOKA 性能体验的款式吸引新消费者，同时扩展到生活方式穿着场合。我们预计这些投资的效益将持续一季又一季地持续积累，目前的产品种类代表了这一战略提升的早期阶段，并且在 2027 年春季及以后将会出现更多令人兴奋的事情。"},{"id":37,"startTime":832.77,"endTime":850,"speaker":"Stefano Caroti","speakerType":"management","en":"On that front, I'd like to highlight one of our most recent launches, the first ever Clifton Pro.
